correctness.rationale: Fixed simplices under color permutation are unions of color orbits in each cycle row. With s chosen orbits, oriented augmented alternating trace contribution is -(-1)^s. Two adjacent nonempty color rows in C_m×K_n must equal the same singleton fixed color; aggregate signed weight of all other nonempty invariant choices is f−1 since total nonempty orbit-subset weight is -1. Transfer matrix has f−1 dimensional -1 eigenspace and 3×3 quotient charpoly t³−(f−1), with f=0 handled by cancellation of spurious -1 eigenvalue. Thus cyclic trace Z_m=3(f−1)^r+(-1)^r(f−1) when m=3r and (-1)^m(f−1) otherwise. Reduced Lefschetz is −Z_m. Applying published pure homology degree 2r−1 yields actual character for m divisible by 3; otherwise only virtual Euler character. Independently enumerated invariant independent faces for all permutations n=2,3 and m=3,4,5; exact matches. Scope is rational, no integral/dihedral assertion.
